meta.name: web-research-assistant
meta.description: AI-powered web research assistant that leverages BrowserAct API to supplement restricted web access by searching the internet for additional information. Designed for OpenClaw and Claude Code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 联网搜索补充信息，突破访问限制
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在受限环境中获取网络信息
copy.tagline_en: Search the web to supplement restricted access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to access web information in restricted environments

howto.what: 当直接访问网页受限时，自动通过 BrowserAct API 搜索互联网，提取标题、摘要、关键事实等结构化信息，并生成研究报告。
howto.when: 当 Claude 需要获取网络信息但目标网站被屏蔽、有地理限制或付费墙时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索最新的 AI 技术趋势。
say.note: 触发默认搜索，返回结果摘要。

say.text: 用必应搜索过去一周的新闻，关于市场趋势。
say.note: 指定搜索引擎和时间范围。

howto.what_en: When direct web access is restricted, automatically searches the internet via BrowserAct API, extracts structured data like titles, snippets, key facts, and generates a research report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude needs web info but target sites are blocked, geo-restricted, or behind paywalls.

say_en.text: Search for the latest AI technology trends.
say_en.note: Triggers default search, returns result summaries.

say_en.text: Search Bing for news from the past week about market trends.
say_en.note: Specifies search engine and time range.
